purpose: Proposed mapping from catalog JSON primary_muscles[] tokens to the sheet Log_Cleaned Muscle_Group vocabulary. INERT in PR-A: no runtime code reads this file. UNCALIBRATED: not yet reconciled against a live Muscle_Group value dump (no sheet access in this environment). classifies_as records how services/analytics.js classifyMuscleGroup would bucket each proposed label today.

classifier_reference.order_note: hinge before lower; pull before push. Rear Delts -> pull; Posterior Chain -> hinge.

front_delts.label: Shoulders
front_delts.owner_decision: split front/side/rear delts, or keep coarse "Shoulders"?

side_delts.label: Shoulders
side_delts.owner_decision: split front/side/rear delts, or keep coarse "Shoulders"?

rear_delts.label: Rear Delts
rear_delts.critical: MUST classify as pull (pull regex precedes push); do not fold into "Shoulders".

forearms.label: Arms
forearms.owner_decision: "Arms" classifies as null under classifyMuscleGroup (no push/pull/hinge/lower/core match). Acceptable if forearms is never a recovery-tracked primary; otherwise map to "Biceps"(pull) or a dedicated pattern.

hamstrings.label: Posterior Chain
hamstrings.note: Sheet convention: hamstrings -> Posterior Chain (hinge), not "Legs"(lower).

calves.label: Calves
calves.blocker: classifyMuscleGroup("Calves") returns null: services/analytics.js lower regex matches the token "calf", not "calves". A future inversion that writes "Calves" would drop calf work out of the lower/recovery pattern. Fix belongs in analytics (add "calve?s?"), NOT in this data-only PR.

lower_back.label: Posterior Chain
lower_back.note: lower_back -> Posterior Chain (hinge). Also matches the "lower back" hinge token directly.

do_not_edit: Proposed only. Final labels require an owner decision on the flagged owner_decision points AND calibration against a live Muscle_Group dump before anything consumes this file.
